summary: Sign-up tries each brand's username on every social; where a page says it is taken (Instagram, TikTok), the app puts the next numbered one in the box (bunnywhispers1, 2 …) and saves it as that social's own username. Sign-ups always use the 1983-06-05 birthday again, and the fill banner says when the sign-up email already has an account (log in instead).

changes.old: optional; enter the correct date for sign-up

spots.note: site_username command + USERNAME_SCRIPT (reads/sets the username box, detects 'not available'); 'already signed up' banner hint; tests
DEFAULT_SIGNUP_BIRTHDAY 1983-06-05, HANDLE_LIMITS, numberedHandle, migrateWorkspace resets birthdays of profiles not created yet
username check loop on Instagram/TikTok, saves the page's username when marked created, birthday always the default
one-click add social carries the sign-up birthday
